title.description: Title displayed in the browser window and header.

hostname.description: Hostname displayed in the header. If empty, uses the system hostname.

refresh_rate.description: Refresh rate of the graphs in seconds.

netstats_in_bps.description: Show network stats in bits per second (y/n).

max_historic_years.description: Maximum number of years of historical data to keep.

accept_selfsigned_certs.description: Accept self-signed certificates for external services (y/n).

image_format.description: Image format for graphs (PNG or JPEG).

enable_parallelizing.description: Enable parallel processing for graph generation (y/n).

base_dir.description: Base directory for Monitorix web files.

base_lib.description: Base library directory for Monitorix data.

base_url.description: Base URL for Monitorix web interface.

base_cgi.description: Base URL for Monitorix CGI scripts.

builtin_host.description: Host to bind the built-in HTTPD to.

builtin_user.description: User to run the built-in HTTPD as.

builtin_group.description: Group to run the built-in HTTPD as.

builtin_log_file.description: Log file for the built-in HTTPD.

builtin_hosts_deny.description: Hosts denied access to the built-in HTTPD.

builtin_hosts_allow.description: Hosts allowed access to the built-in HTTPD.

builtin_autocheck_responsiveness.description: Auto check responsiveness of the built-in HTTPD (y/n).

auth_enabled.description: Enable authentication for the built-in HTTPD (y/n).

auth_hosts_deny.description: Hosts denied access when auth is enabled.

auth_msg.description: Message displayed when restricted access is triggered.

auth_htpasswd.description: Path to the htpasswd file for authentication.

mail_log.description: Path to the mail log file.

ftp_log.description: Path to the FTP log file.

fail2ban_log.description: Path to the fail2ban log file.

spamassassin_log.description: Path to the SpamAssassin log file.

clamav_log.description: Path to the ClamAV log file.

squid_log.description: Path to the Squid log file.

serv_list.default: Default = SSH, FTP, TELNET, IMAP, Samba, Fax, CUPS, POP3, SMTP, Spam, Virus, Fail2ban

serv_desc.default:
SSH = C, file:/var/log/secure, "^%b %e", "sshd\[.*\]: Accepted "
		FTP = C, file:/var/log/secure, "%b %e", "START: ftp" + " proftpd\[.*Login successful." + "\"PASS .*\" 230"
		FTP = C, file:/var/log/secure, "%b %e", "OK LOGIN:"
		FTP = C, file:/var/log/secure, "%b %e", "\[INFO\] .*? is now logged in"
		TELNET = C, file:/var/log/secure, "^%b %e", "START: telnet"
		Samba = G, exec:/usr/local/bin/samba.sh, "", ""
		Fax = C, file:/var/spool/hylafax/etc/xferfaxlog, "^%m/%d/%y", "SEND"
		CUPS = C, file:/var/log/cups/page_log, "\[%d/%b/%Y:", ""
		Fail2ban = C, file:/var/log/fail2ban.log, "^%Y-%m-%d", " fail2ban.actions .* Ban "
		IMAP = C, file:/var/log/imap, "%b %d", " imapd\[.* Login user="
		POP3 = C, file:/var/log/imap, "%b %d", " ipop3d\[.* Login user="
		IMAP = C, file:/var/log/imap, "%b %d", " imap-login: .* Login: "
		POP3 = C, file:/var/log/imap, "%b %d", " pop3-login: .* Login: "
		SMTP = C, file:/var/log/maillog, "^%b %e", i:"to=.*stat(us)?=sent"
		Spam = C, file:/var/log/maillog, "^%b %e", "MailScanner.*Spam Checks:.*Found.*spam messages" + "amavis\[.* SPAM"
		Spam = C, file:/var/log/maillog, "^%b %e", "spamd: identified spam"
		Virus = C, file:/var/log/maillog, "^%b %e", "MailScanner.*Virus Scanning:.*Found.*viruses" + "amavis\[.* INFECTED|amavis\[.* BANNED"
		Virus = C, file:/var/log/messages, "^%b %e", " clamd\[.* FOUND$"
